blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Meaning identity—whether two sentences say the same thing after the wording has changed—is treated throughout retrieval and RAG as a geometric fact about independently encoded sentence vectors.
We show that, for frozen off-the-shelf encoders and language models, it is not: identity is computed when both sentences occupy the same forward pass, and it is not a property of the embedding geometry those systems ship.
On overlap-matched PAWS-X, purpose-built encoders (BGE, E5, GTE, MiniLM, and E5-Mistral-7B) reach English confirm AUC only 0.55 0.55 – 0.65 0.65 (dense peak 0.70 0.70 ; n = 900 n{=}900 ).
Independently encoded last-token states of Llama 3, Mistral, and Qwen do no better; a linear probe on the concatenation of the two vectors ( late fusion ) remains near chance.
The same probe on the last token of a joint forward pass over both sentences reaches 0.90 0.90 – 0.96 0.96 from 1.5B through 32B, and shuffling sentence B collapses it to chance; the signal is mid-depth, saturates near 0.94 0.94 by 3B, and is already present, more weakly, in GPT-2 XL ( 0.76 0.76 ).
The pattern is not a Llama-family artefact: the same four readouts on non-Qwen/Llama/Mistral causal models, on bidirectional encoders (DeBERTa, RoBERTa), and on encoder–decoders (Flan-T5, T5, BART) again give joint ≫ \gg late fusion with shuffle near chance.
No fixed or linear reader over frozen independent encodings—cosine, token-level MaxSim, late fusion—makes identity accessible at any training size; nonlinear pair readers trained from scratch, an MLP over the two vectors or a cross-attention module over the frozen token sequences, recover part of it only on the full 49k-pair PAWS train split ( 0.68 0.68 – 0.87 0.87 ), forty times the pairs the joint probe needs.
Off-the-shelf rerankers split the same way: BGE-reranker-large reaches 0.94 0.94 , but MS-MARCO and Jina rerankers stay in the dense band ( 0.55 0.55 – 0.64 0.64 ): joint scoring is necessary, not sufficient.
Independently trained families compute the same relation: their joint scores agree, their errors co-occur, and a 1.5B joint reader distilled from unlabelled teacher-scored pairs recovers it, while no linear function of the teacher’s own independent vectors can.
A bi-encoder can be fine-tuned to fit PAWS (AUC 0.87 0.87 – 0.93 0.93 ), but the fit is a PAWS-specific criterion: transfer to overlap-matched QQP drops and STS-B Spearman falls by about 0.25 0.25 .
Off-the-shelf cosine compares wording neighbourhoods; identity is a cheap computed operator, not a property of either sentence’s vector.
blocks.zh:
意思是身份——无论两句是否在措辞改变后说同样的话——在整个检索和RAG中都被视为关于独立编码的句子矢量的几何事实。
我们显示,对于现成的冷冻编码器和语言模型来说,它不是:当两个句子占据相同的前传时,身份是计算出来的,它不是嵌入式几何系统船的财产。
在重叠匹配的PAWS-X上,专用建造的编码器(BGE,E5,GTE,MiniLM,以及E5-Mistral-7B)达到英语确认AUC仅0.55 0.55 – 0.65 0.65(强度峰值0.70 0.70;n = 900 n{=}900).
独立地编码了Llama 3,Mistral,和Quen的最后一个托肯状态,没有比这更好的了;对于两个向量的结合(后聚变)的线性探测器仍然几乎是偶然的.
联合前进的最后一个标志上的同一探测器在两个句子上分别通过0.90 0.90 — — 0.96 0.96 从 1.5B到 32B, 并将句子B 折叠到偶然;信号是中深,饱和度接近0.94 0.94 by 3B, 并且已经存在, 更弱的是在 GPT-2 XL (0.76 0.76)中.
模式不是Llama-family动脉:在非Quen/Llama/Mistral因果模型、双向编码器(DeBERTa、RoBERTa)和编码器-解码器(Flan-T5、T5、BART)上相同的四个读数再次使联合QQ\gg晚聚,几乎是偶然的。
没有固定或线性阅读器在冻结的独立编码上——Cosine,sorder-level MaxSim,延迟聚变——使身份在任何训练大小上都能被访问;非线性对对阅读器从零开始训练,MLP在两个矢量上训练,或者在冻结的对质序列上安装交叉注意模块,只在全部49k-pair PAWS列车拆分(0.68 0.68–0.87 0.87)上回收部分,40倍于联合探针需要的对.
现成的复级选手以同样的方式分道扬镳:BGE-复级选手大项达到0.94 0.94,但MS-MARCO和Jina复级选手留在密集的乐队(0.55 0.55 – 0.64 0.64):联合评分是必要的,不够.
受过独立训练的家庭计算出同样的关系:他们的联合得分一致,错误共同存在,从无标签的教师-分数对子中提取的1.5B联合阅读器可以恢复,而教师自己的独立向量的线性功能无法恢复。
双编码器可进行微调,以适应PAWS(AUC 0.87 0.87 – 0.93 0.93),但适配标准是PAWS的特定标准:向重叠匹配的QQP滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴,STS-B Spearman下降约0.250.25.
现成的余弦比较措辞邻里; 身份是廉价的计算操作者, 而不是任何句子矢量的财产。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A sentence embedding is an invitation to treat meaning as a point.
Once each sentence has a vector, “same meaning” becomes cosine, and the industrial stack—dense retrieval, duplicate-question detection, RAG—is built on that geometry ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Muennighoff et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) .
The invitation is so familiar that it is easy to miss the empirical claim it encodes: that identity of meaning is a property of a single sentence’s representation, recoverable by comparing two such properties.
blocks.zh:
句子嵌入是邀请将意义当作点.
一旦每个句子都有一个矢量,“同一含义”就变成余弦,而工业堆栈——感应检索、重复问题探测、RAG——就是以该几何学为基础的(Reimers and Gurevich, 2019;Muennighoff等人, 2023;Gao等人, 2024)。
这种邀请是十分熟悉的,因此很容易错过它编码的实证主张:这种含义的特性是一个单句代表的财产,通过比较两个这种属性可以收回。

blocks.en:
That claim can be false even if embeddings are useful.
They can rank topical neighbours, cluster documents, and win STS ( Cer et al., 2017 ) while still being nearly blind to the distinction PAWS was built to isolate: two sentences that share almost all of their words, one of which is a paraphrase and one of which is not ( Zhang et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2019 ) .
If identity is not in the vectors, then every system that first encodes and then compares is looking in the wrong place for a large class of hard pairs.
blocks.zh:
即使嵌入物有用,这种说法也可能是虚假的。
他们可以对热门邻居,集群文件进行排序,并赢得STS(Cer et al., 2017年),而对于区别却几乎视而不见 PAWS 的构建是为了孤立:两句几乎都一样的句子,其中一句是引喻,一句不是(张等人, 2019年;杨等人, 2019年).
如果身份不在矢量中,那么首先编码然后比较的每个系统都会在错误的地方寻找一大类硬对.

blocks.en: We separate two pictures, on identical items, with a metric whose chance level is exactly 0.5 0.5 :
blocks.zh: 我们把两张照片分开,放在相同的物品上, 其概率为0.5:

blocks.en: Each sentence carries an identity. Cosine, a pair probe, or late fusion of the two vectors should recover it.
blocks.zh: 每句带个身份. 余弦,一对探测器,或两个载体的晚聚变应恢复.

blocks.en:
Identity is a relation the network computes when both sentences occupy the same context.
It is then readable from the last token of a concatenated forward pass, and not from any fixed or linear function of the two separately encoded states.
blocks.zh:
当两个句子占据同一上下文时,身份是网络计算的一种关系.
然后,它可以从复刻前传的最后一个符号读取,而不是从两个单独编码的状态的任何固定或线性函数读取。

blocks.en: The pictures are not rhetorical: late fusion gives a linear probe both vectors and no cross-attention, so if geometry were merely “misaligned with cosine” it would close the gap; a shuffled-partner joint pass preserves format, language, and the marginal of sentence B while destroying pairing, so a probe reading a template rather than the pairing would survive it.
blocks.zh: 图片不是夸夸其谈的:晚聚变既给出了线性探测器,又没有交叉注意,所以如果几何学只是“与余弦相配合”的话,它就会缩小差距;一个洗牌的合作伙伴联合通行证在破坏配对的同时保留了格式,语言和句子B的边缘,所以一个探测器读一个模板而不是配对就可以幸存下来.

blocks.en:
We find computation, not geometry, across modern open families (Table 1 , Figure 1 ).
On overlap-matched English PAWS-X, Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B, and Qwen2.5 from 1.5B to 32B all yield joint confirm AUC 0.90 0.90 – 0.96 0.96 at mid-depth, while separate cosine, a separate pair probe, and late fusion remain in 0.47 0.47 – 0.61 0.61 ; partner shuffle returns to ≈ 0.50 \approx 0.50 ; dedicated encoders never leave the 0.55 0.55 – 0.70 0.70 band.
GPT-2 is not a counterexample species: the same joint circuit appears more weakly, and only XL clearly pulls away ( 0.76 0.76 ).
Outside that stack the same protocol holds for Phi-2, GPT-J-6B, OPT-6.7B, GPT-Neo, Pythia, and SmolLM2 (joint 0.75 0.75 – 0.90 0.90 ), for mean-pooled DeBERTa/RoBERTa encoders (DeBERTa-v3 0.92 0.92 , nli-DeBERTa 0.94 0.94 ), and for encoder–decoders (Flan-T5-base 0.95 0.95 ; T5-small / BART-base 0.64 0.64 – 0.66 0.66 ).
A nonce-substitution control keeps joint above late fusion with shuffle near chance on Qwen and on non-Qwen causals.
Qwen base models can also say the answer (zero-shot verdict AUC 0.92 0.92 – 0.99 0.99 from 3B to 32B); Llama 3 and Mistral compute the relation at 0.90 0.90 while their verbal verdict stays ≈ 0.61 \approx 0.61 .
blocks.zh:
我们发现现代开放家庭的计算,而不是几何(表1,图1)。
在重叠匹配的英语PAWS-X,Llama 3 8B,Mistral 7B,和Qun2.5从1.5B到32B均在中深处产生联合确认AUC 0.90 0.90 – 0.96 0.96,而分离的余弦,单对探测器,晚聚变则保持在0.47 0.47 – 0.61 0.61;合作伙伴洗涤器返回QQ 0.50\ 0.50;专用编码器从不离开0.55 0.55 – 0.70 0.70的频带.
GPT-2不是一个反例物种:相同的联线显示较弱,只有XL明显拉开(0.76 0.76 ).
该堆栈之外,Phi-2、GPT-J-6B、OPT-6.7B、GPT-Neo、Pythia和SmolLM2(联合0.75 0.75 – 0.90 0.90),平均组合的DeBERTa/RoBERTa编码器(DEBERTa-v3 0.92 0.92,nli-DeBERTa 0.94 0.94),以及编码器-编码器的同一协议。 (Flan-T5基0.95 0.95; T5小/BART基0.64 0.64 – 0.66 0.66).
非ce-替代控制使联合在晚聚变之上,在Quen和非Quen因果上与shuffle接近机会.
Quen基础模型也可以说答案(零镜头判决AUC 0.92 0.92 – 0.99 0.99 从3B到32B);Llama 3和Mistral 计算关系为 0.90 0.90,而他们的口头判决则保持QQ 0.61\约0.61.

blocks.en:
Two further findings sharpen the claim from “not geometry” to “one computed operator”.
First, six independently trained models (Qwen, Llama, Mistral) compute measurably the same relation: their item-level scores agree far beyond the labels, their errors co-occur, and the relation is symmetric and graded (§ 6 ).
Second, the operator is cheap and deployable: a 1.5B joint reader trained only on the consensus of three cross-family teachers over unlabelled text matches the 7B teacher on PAWS ( 0.959 0.959 ) and repairs a cosine FAQ stack on wording twins (trapped top-1 0.47 → 0.88 0.47\to 0.88 ) without touching the retrieval index (§ 9 ).
blocks.zh:
还有两项调查结果使索赔从“非几何”变为“一个计算出来的操作员”。
首先,6个经过独立训练的模型(Quen,Llama,Mistral)计算出可以衡量的相同关系:他们的项目级别分数一致,远远超出标签,其错误是共同的,关系是对称和分级的(§6).
其次,操作员价格低廉且可部署:一个1.5B的联读器只接受了三名跨家庭教师对无标签文本的共识培训,与7B的教师在PAWS(0.959 0.959)上相匹配,并在双胞胎文字上修补一个余弦FAQ堆(搭载在顶部-1 0.47 —0.88 0.47\=0.88)而不触及检索指数(§9).

blocks.en: The implication is not that embeddings should be discarded, but that they should not be asked to certify identity: a stack that retrieves “the same question asked differently” is asking a bi-encoder to do a cross-encoder’s job, and the shipped geometry of current LMs does not contain that job.
blocks.zh: 其含义并不是说嵌入器应该被丢弃,而是不应该要求它们验证身份:一个收回 " 不同问题 " 的堆栈是要求双编码器做交叉编码器的工作,运来的当前LM的几何并不包含这项工作。

blocks.en: Related work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en:
Sentence embeddings trained with siamese or contrastive objectives ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) dominate retrieval benchmarks ( Thakur et al., 2021 ; Muennighoff et al., 2023 ) .
The retrieval literature already knows that cross -encoders, which read the pair jointly, outperform bi-encoders on reranking ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ; Khattab and Zaharia, 2020 ) .
That fact is usually treated as a compute/quality tradeoff.
We show it is sharper: BGE rerankers reach the joint-probe band on overlap-matched PAWS, while MS-MARCO and Jina rerankers do not—joint scoring alone does not imply identity.
We treat it as evidence about where the information is accessible : if every fixed or linear reader over two frozen encodings stays near chance at any training size, while pair computations trained from scratch over the same encodings need forty times the pairs of a joint-pass probe to approach it, the gap is not a scoring detail—identity becomes accessible only through a computation over the pair (the claim is about accessibility to trained readouts, not information-theoretic absence).
Late interaction ( Khattab and Zaharia, 2020 ) still encodes independently, then scores a function of the two sequences; our late-fusion probe and MaxSim are its sentence- and token-level analogues.
blocks.zh:
以暹罗式或对比式目标训练的嵌入式(Reimers and Gurevich, 2019;Gao等人, 2021;Wang等人, 2022;Xiao等人, 2024)在检索基准中占主导地位(Thakur等人, 2021;Muennighoff等人, 2023)。
检索文献已经知道交叉编码器,它们联合阅读对子,在重新排位上超越双编码器(Nogueira and Cho, 2019; Khattab and Zaharia, 2020).
这一事实通常被视为计算/质量权衡。
我们显示它更尖锐:BGE重排手在重叠匹配的PAWS上到达联合-probe乐队,而MS-MARCO和Jina重排手则没有——单靠联合得分并不意味着身份.
我们把它当作信息可在哪里获取的证据:如果两个冻结编码上的每个固定或线性阅读器在任何训练规模上都保持几近机会,而在同一编码上从零开始训练的对数计算则需要联合通道探测器对数的40倍才能接近它,差距并不是一个评分细节——只有在对数上进行计算才能获得身份(要求是获得经过训练的读数,而不是信息理论缺失)。
晚期交互(Khattab and Zaharia, 2020)仍然独立编码,然后对两个序列的函数进行分数;我们的晚期聚变探测器和MaxSim是它的句子和符号级模拟.

blocks.en:
Probing work asks what is linearly readable from LM states ( Alain and Bengio, 2017 ; Tenney et al., 2019 ; Hewitt and Manning, 2019 ; Pimentel et al., 2020 ; Belinkov and Glass, 2019 ) .
The linear representation hypothesis ( Park et al., 2024 ) concerns directions inside a model.
Recent probes on modern open models sharpen the same map: lexical identity is linearly strongest early and weakens with depth ( Li and Subramani, 2026 ) , while semantic and syntactic signals occupy partly separable mid-depth regimes ( Acevedo et al., 2026 ) , and lexical overlap continues to distort independent-embedding similarity under paraphrase stress tests ( Rizwan et al., 2026 ) .
Our question is narrower and prior to that geometry: whether the relation “these two sentences are paraphrases” is a function of two independent points at all.
blocks.zh:
探险工作询问LM状态的线性可读性是什么(Alain and Bengio, 2017;Tenney等人, 2019;Hewitt and Manning, 2019;Pimentel等人, 2020;Belinkov and Glass, 2019).
线性表示假说(Park et al., 2024)涉及一个模型内部的方向.
近代开放模型上的探测器将相同的地图磨亮: 词汇特征早期线性最强,并随着深度而减弱(Li and Subramani, 2026年),而语义信号和合成信号占据部分可分离的中深度系统(Acevedo等人, 2026年),词汇重叠在参数压力测试(Rizwan等人, 2026年)下继续扭曲独立嵌入的相似性.
我们的问题比较狭义,在几何之前:“这两句是解释”的关系是否完全由两个独立点组成。

blocks.en:
PAWS and PAWS-X ( Zhang et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2019 ) adversarialise bag-of-words overlap.
Broader paraphrase evaluation has since moved beyond a single classification set ( Michail et al., 2025 ) ; we stay with overlap-matched PAWS-style identity because that is exactly where shipped bi-encoder geometry is asked to certify sameness and fails.
We go further and match overlap between paraphrase and non-paraphrase cells, so a scorer that only sees word overlap is at chance—the setting in which identity, if it exists as geometry, would have to show itself.
blocks.zh:
PAWS和PAWS-X(Zhang等人,2019年;Yang等人,2019年) 对抗包字重叠.
从那时起,广义的参数评价已经超越了单一的分类集(Michail等人,2025年);我们坚持重叠的PAWS式身份,因为这正是要求运出双编码器几何来证明相同性和失败的地方。
我们走得更远,在句法与非句法的单元格之间匹配重叠,所以一个只看到字词重叠的记分器是偶然的——如果身份存在为几何的设定,就必须显示自己.

blocks.en: Protocol
blocks.zh: 议定书

blocks.en:
We sample PAWS-X English and Chinese pairs into discovery / development / confirm splits, and inside each language × \times split cell we match lexical overlap of paraphrases and non-paraphrases (English confirm overlap gap typically < 0.02 <0.02 ), so the overlap-only AUC on English confirm is ≈ 0.47 \approx 0.47 – 0.55 0.55 .
Joint-probe confirm cells contain 150 150 – 500 500 pairs ( 600 600 – 2000 2000 discovery); the 32B cell is the smallest ( 150 150 ), and its interval is reported wherever it is used.
We report AUC rather than forced-choice accuracy so that a constant anisotropic offset cannot move the number ( Ethayarajh, 2019 ) , and bootstrap 95% intervals on confirm; chance is exactly 0.5 0.5 regardless of class balance.
blocks.zh:
我们把 PAWS-X 英文和中文的对子抽样到发现 / development / 确认分裂,在每种语言 \\ times 分裂单元格中,我们匹配词句和非词句的词汇重叠(英语确认重叠漏洞通常 < 0.02 < 0.02),所以在英语确认上只重叠的AUC是 \ 0.47\ 大约0.47 — 0.55 0.55。
联合检测确认细胞包含150–500对500对(600–600–2000年发现);32B细胞是最小的(150–150),无论使用在哪里,其间隔都报告.
我们报告的是AUC而不是强制选择的准确性,这样一个恒定的异位抵消不能移动数字(Ethayarajh, 2019年), 以及固定的95%的间隔; 不论等级平衡, 概率完全是0.5。

blocks.en:
For each frozen causal LM we score the same pairs four ways. Separate cosine : last-token states from independent forwards, cosine. Separate probe : a logistic probe on ( 𝐡 1 ⊙ 𝐡 2 , | 𝐡 1 − 𝐡 2 | ) (\mathbf{h}_{1}\odot\mathbf{h}_{2},\,|\mathbf{h}_{1}-\mathbf{h}_{2}|) after a PCA map fit on discovery. Late fusion : the same probe class on [ 𝐡 1 ; 𝐡 2 ] [\mathbf{h}_{1};\mathbf{h}_{2}] —both vectors present, no mixing inside the LM. Joint probe : the two sentences are concatenated with a language-specific template that is not a yes/no question ( A: … / B: … ); we probe the last token of that joint pass.
Probes are fit on discovery, regularisation is selected on development, and scores are reported only on confirm.
Table 1 lists each model at its layer of peak confirm joint AUC; locking the layer on development instead picks the same layer for 26 of 30 models and changes confirm joint AUC by 0.001 0.001 on average and at most 0.011 0.011 (32B: L48, 0.927 0.927 instead of L58, 0.938 0.938 ).
blocks.zh:
对于每个被冻结的因果LM,我们得分 相同的对四种方式。 分离的cosine : 最后一个托肯状态从独立的前方,cosine. 单独探测器:在发现时适合的五氯苯甲醚地图后,在(h 1 ⊙ h ⊙ h 2, | h 1 }_{ h 2 | | |)上进行后勤探测器。 晚聚变:在[h 1;h 2] [\ mathb{h}_{1};\mathb{h}_{2}]上相同的探针类——两种矢量都存在,在LM内没有混合. 联合探针:两句用一个语言特定的模板拼凑,这个模板不是一个是/否的问题(A:./B:.);我们探针那个联合传球的最后一个符号.
探测器在发现时适合,在开发时选择规范化,只有在确认时报告分数。
表1列出了每个型号在其峰值层上确认联合AUC;将开发层锁定在30种型号中的26种为同一层,变化则确认联合AUC平均为0.0010.001,最多为0.0110.011(32B:L48,0.927 0.927,而不是L58,0.938 0.938).

blocks.en:
Sentence B is replaced by another sentence from the same language and split: format, language, and the marginal of B are preserved; pairing is destroyed.
A probe that reads “two sentences appeared” rather than “these two belong together” will survive shuffle.
blocks.zh:
判决 B被来自同一种语言和分词的另一句所取代:格式,语言,以及B的边缘被保留;配对被破坏.
将“两句出现”而不是“这两句属于一起”读作“两句出现”的探测器将幸存下来。

blocks.en: We record last-token states at a fixed grid of relative depths, plus the final-norm input (prenorm, captured by hook—HuggingFace hidden_states[-1] is already post-norm) and output (postnorm).
blocks.zh: 我们在固定的相对深度网格中记录最后的状态,加上最后的规范输入(prenorm,由钩子捕获——HuggingFace隐藏的_states[-1]已经是postnorm)和输出(postnorm).

blocks.en: A zero-shot yes/no verdict, length-normalised PMI, and conditional surprisal are scored on a smaller overlap-matched draw; unlike the joint probe, these ask the model to speak .
blocks.zh: 零镜头是/否判断,长度常态化的PMI,以及有条件的超额在较小的重叠比对图上得分;与联合探针不同的是,这些要求模型说话.

blocks.en: Nineteen public dense checkpoints (BGE, E5, GTE, MiniLM, mpnet, multilingual E5, E5-Mistral-7B) and six cross-encoders (three BGE rerankers, two MS-MARCO MiniLM rerankers, and Jina reranker-v2) are scored on a dedicated overlap-matched bank with n = 900 n{=}900 confirm pairs per language, fixed sampling seeds, and English overlap matching (confirm overlap gap − 0.002 -0.002 ); bi-encoders and rerankers score the same items.
blocks.zh: 19个公共密集检查站(BGE、E5、GTE、MiniLM、mpnet、多语种E5、E5-Mistral-7B)和6个交叉编码器(3个BGE重新编号器、2个MS-MARCO微型LM重新编号器和Jina重新编号器-v2)在一个专用重叠匹配的银行上得分,每个语言的n=900n{=}900确认对,固定抽样种子,以及英语重叠匹配(确认重叠缺口−0.002-0.00);双编码器和重新编号器得分相同的项目。

blocks.en: (P1) Computation: joint ≫ \gg late fusion, and late fusion stays near the separate-probe band. (P2) Geometry: late fusion ≈ \approx joint, both well above chance. (P3) Shuffle must fall to chance. (P4) Report the first depth whose confirm 95% interval excludes 0.55 0.55 .
blocks.zh: (P1) 计算:联合QQ\gg 晚聚变,晚聚变停留在分离-probe波段附近. (P2)几何学:晚聚变 QQ \ 近似关节,两者都远高于机会. (P3) Shuffle必须倒下的机会。 (P4)报告第一个深度,确认的95%间隔不包括0.55 0.55。

blocks.en: Geometry does not carry identity
blocks.zh: 几何不包含身份

blocks.en:
Dedicated encoders fail on overlap-matched confirm.
The strongest English cosine is 0.701 0.701 (BGE-large-zh); the strongest English- trained checkpoint is mpnet-base ( 0.653 0.653 ).
Typical retrieval encoders sit at 0.55 0.55 – 0.65 0.65 ; scaling to E5-Mistral-7B does not break the band ( 0.613 0.613 ).
A linear probe on frozen encoder vectors moves English BGE-small only from 0.588 0.588 to 0.607 0.607 , and BGE-large-zh from 0.701 0.701 to 0.710 0.710 : the information is not “there but rotated”.
blocks.zh:
专用编码器在重叠匹配的确认上失败.
最强的英语余音为0.701 0.701(BGE-group-zh);最强的英语训练检查站为mpnet-base(0.653 0.653 ).
典型的检索编码器坐落在0.55 0.55 – 0.65 0.65;缩放到E5-Mistral-7B不会打破波段(0.613 0.613 ).
冷冻编码器载体上的线性探测器只将英国BGE小号从0.588 0.588移动到0.607 0.607,而BGE大号-zh从0.701 0.701移动到0.710 0.710:信息不是“那里而是旋转的”。

blocks.en:
Not every cross-encoder computes identity.
BGE-reranker-large ( 0.940 0.940 ), v2-m3 ( 0.902 0.902 ), and base ( 0.888 0.888 ) align with the joint-probe band of § 5 .
Jina reranker-v2 ( 0.639 0.639 ) and MS-MARCO MiniLM rerankers ( 0.545 0.545 – 0.558 0.558 ) also read the pair jointly but stay in the dense band—they score passage relevance, not PAWS-style identity.
The gap is therefore not “cross-encoder beats bi-encoder”; it is that only some joint computations implement the identity operator.
blocks.zh:
不是每个交叉编码器都计算身份
BGE-ranker-大(0.940 0.940),v2-m3(0.902 0.902),和基(0.888 0.888)与§5的联合-探测波段一致.
Jina reranker-v2(0.639 0.639)和MS-MARCO MiniLM rerankers(0.545 0.545 – 0.558 0.558)也共同阅读了对子,但停留在密集的波段中——他们得分通过相关,而不是PAWS式的身份.
因此,这一空白不是“交叉编码器比双编码器“;而是只有一些联合计算执行身份操作员。

blocks.en:
Independently encoded LM last-token states tell the same story (Table 1 , columns Cos and Sep; cf. Figure 1 ).
Across Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B, Qwen2.5 (0.5B–14B), GPT-2, GPT-Neo-125M, and Pythia, English separate cosine at the joint-peak layer is 0.52 0.52 – 0.61 0.61 , and the best pair probe on those two vectors is 0.51 0.51 – 0.62 0.62 .
Late fusion, the upper bound of “just having two vectors”, remains 0.47 0.47 – 0.57 0.57 for every modern 3–14B model we ran (Qwen2.5-14B 0.541 0.541 ): P2 fails, and the 14B cosine of 0.614 0.614 , the highest geometric number in the table, is still four tenths of AUC below the joint probe.
blocks.zh:
独立编码的 LM 最后一个音标州讲述同样的故事(表1,列Cos和Sep;参考图1)。
跨Llama 3 8B,Mistral 7B,Qun2.5(0.5B–14B),GPT-2,GPT-Neo-125M,以及Pythia,联合峰层的英语独立大同分线探测器为0.52 0.52 – 0.61 0.61,这两个矢量上的最佳对偶探测器为0.51 0.51 – 0.62 0.62.
晚聚变,即“只有两个矢量”的上限,仍然是0.47 0.47 — 0.57 0.57,我们运行的每一个现代的3–14B型号(Quen2.5-14B 0.541 0.541 ):P2失败,表内最高几何数的0.614 0.614 的14B 余弦仍然比联合探测器低十分之四。

blocks.en:
Identity might instead live in the token sequences : on the same confirm items, ColBERT-style MaxSim of last-layer tokens reaches 0.62 0.62 – 0.71 0.71 across Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B, Phi-2, GPT-J-6B, OPT-6.7B, and Qwen2.5 3B–32B (best: Qwen7B at 0.708 0.708 , 95% CI [ 0.649 , 0.767 ] [0.649,0.767] ); mean-pool cosine sits in 0.57 0.57 – 0.64 0.64 , and a two-layer MLP on the concatenated last-tokens, fit on the 1.2 1.2 k discovery pairs, stays at chance ( 0.47 0.47 – 0.56 0.56 ).
Scale does not move it into a fixed similarity: 14B MaxSim ( 0.628 0.628 ) is lower than 7B’s, 32B MaxSim 0.694 0.694 is 0.24 0.24 below its joint 0.938 0.938 , and Phi-2’s MaxSim equals 7B’s ( 0.701 0.701 vs joint 0.893 0.893 ): MaxSim saturates early as residual lexical matching.
blocks.zh:
身份可能活在符号序列中:在同一确认物品上,上层符号的ColBERT式MaxSim达到0.62 0.62 — 0.71 0.71,横跨Llama 3 8B,Mistral 7B,Phi-2,GPT-J-6B,OPP-6.7B,和Qun2.5 3B-32B(最好:Quen7B at 0.708 0.708, 95% CI [0.649, 0.67] [0.649, 0.767]); 平均池型大肠素坐落在0.57 0.57 – 0.64 0.64; 紧贴的最后一趾上有一个两层MLP,适合1.2 k 的发现对,留到偶然之处(0.47 047 – 0.56 0.56 0.56)。
缩放不移动到固定的相似性:14B MaxSim(0.628 0.628)低于7B,32B MaxSim 0.694 0.694 低于其联赛0.938 0.938 0.24,菲-2的MaxSim 等于 7B (0.701 0.701 vs 联赛0.893 0.893 ): MaxSim 饱和早期作为剩余词汇匹配.

blocks.en:
A stronger independent-encoding reader is a small transformer with bidirectional cross-attention over the two frozen token sequences—capacity, nonlinearity, and token-level interaction, but no joint LM pass; it fits a relatedness control (true vs shuffled partner) at confirm 0.98 0.98 – 0.99 0.99 on Qwen2.5-7B encodings, so it can read the sequences.
Trained for identity on the leak-filtered PAWS-X train split it stays at confirm 0.46 0.46 – 0.58 0.58 through 20 20 k pairs on every model; the full 49 49 k pairs lift it to 0.68 0.68 – 0.70 0.70 (Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B, Qwen2.5 3B/7B) and 0.87 0.87 (Qwen14B).
A logistic late fusion of the two sentence vectors stays at 0.52 0.52 – 0.58 0.58 on the same 49 49 k pairs; an MLP on the pooled pair reaches 0.72 0.72 – 0.75 0.75 .
The token sequences carry the material; unlocking it takes a pair computation and forty times the labels the LM’s own joint pass needs ( 0.90 0.90 – 0.95 0.95 from 1.2 1.2 k).
blocks.zh:
更强的独立编码读取器是一个小变压器,在两个冷冻的符号序列上双向交叉——容量,非线性,和符号级交互,但没有联合LM通道;它符合关联性控制(真 vs shuffled partner),以确认0.98 0.98 – 0.99 0.99 在Quen2.5-7B编码上,可以读取序列.
在漏滤式PAWS-X列车上进行身份训练后,它以确认的0.46 0.46 – 0.58 0.58 – 20 k对每个车型上分别停留;全49 49 k对提升到0.68 0.68 – 0.70 (Llama 3 8 B, Mistral 7 B, Quen2.5 3 B/7 B)和0.87 0.87 (Quen14 B).
两句矢量的后勤晚聚变保持在0.52 0.52 — 0.58 0.58,同一49 k对;集合对的MLP达到0.72 0.72 — 0.75 0.75。
符号序列携带材料;解锁需要一对计算,标签为LM自身联通通行证需求的40倍(0.90 0.90– 0.95 0.95 from 1.2 k).

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning the encoder itself is a different question: after leak-filtering PAWS-X train (near-duplicates and generation-template overlap with eval dropped; hyperparameters locked on overlap-matched validation), MiniLM, BGE-small, and BGE-base reach overlap-matched confirm 0.871 0.871 , 0.884 0.884 , and 0.930 0.930 .
Zero-shot transfer of those checkpoints to overlap-matched QQP falls relative to the untuned encoders ( 0.813 → 0.701 0.813{\to}0.701 , 0.824 → 0.739 0.824{\to}0.739 , 0.829 → 0.693 0.829{\to}0.693 ), and STS-B Spearman falls from 0.87 0.87 – 0.90 0.90 to 0.61 0.61 – 0.62 0.62 .
A MiniLM cross -encoder on the same slices hits PAWS confirm 0.906 0.906 only at full train size (chance at 500 500 pairs, 0.67 0.67 at 8 8 k) and still transfers to overlap-matched QQP at 0.651 0.651 .
Vectors can be trained to carry a PAWS identity criterion; they do not, in this protocol, acquire a general meaning-identity geometry, and the fit taxes aboutness.
blocks.zh:
微调编码器本身是一个不同的问题:在泄漏过滤的PAWS-X列车(与eval脱落相近的复制件和生成代模重叠;超参数锁定在重叠匹配的验证上)后,MiniLM,BGE-小,BGE-base达到重叠匹配确认0.871 0.871,0.884 0.884,0.930 0.930.
与未调节的编码器(0.813 ~ 0.701 0.813 ~to}0.701,0.824 → 0.739 0.824 →}0.739,0.829 → 0.693 0.829 →}0.693)相比,这些检查站被零射转至重叠的QQP ,STS-B Spearman从0.87 0.87 0.87 0.90 0.90 降到0.61 0.61 0.62 0.62。
同一切片上的迷你LM交叉-编码器在PAWS上只确认0.906 0.906为全列车尺寸(在500对500对,0.67 0.67为8k),仍以0.651 0.651转至重叠匹配的QQP.
矢量器可以被训练来携带PAWS身份标准;在本协议中,它们不会获得一般意义识别几何,以及适切性税.

blocks.en: Identity appears when the pair is computed
blocks.zh: 计算对称时出现身份

blocks.en: Table 1 (and Figure 1 ) reports, for each model, the depth of peak English joint confirm AUC, together with late fusion, separate cosine, and shuffled joint at that same depth.
blocks.zh: 表1(和图1)报告了每个模型,最高峰英国联合体的深度证实了AUC,加上晚聚变,单独余弦,在同一深度洗动联合体.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Depth of the four readouts.
Joint rises at mid-depth; the other three stay near chance.
Qwen14B keeps the signal into postnorm ( 0.950 → 0.940 0.950\to 0.940 ); Llama spends it ( 0.897 → 0.731 0.897\to 0.731 ).
blocks.zh:
图2:四个读数的深度。
联合在中深处上升;其他三个保持接近机会.
Quen14B使信号进入后标(0.950 → 0.940 0.950\to 0.940);Llama使用(0.897 → 0.731 0.897\to 0.731).

blocks.en:
For Llama, Mistral, and Qwen ≥ 1.5 \geq 1.5 B, joint exceeds late fusion by 0.37 0.37 – 0.46 0.46 AUC (Qwen2.5-14B: 0.950 0.950 versus 0.541 0.541 ); late fusion never leaves the encoder band, so P1 holds and P2 does not.
At the same layer, shuffle AUC is 0.46 0.46 – 0.54 0.54 : the probe reads the pairing, which shuffle destroys, so P3 holds.
blocks.zh:
对于Llama,Mistral,和Quen → 1.5\ geq 1.5 B来说,联想比迟聚变多0.37 0.37 —0.46 046 AUC(Quen2.5-14B:0.950 0.950对0.541 0.541);迟聚变从不离开编码带,所以P1持有,P2没有.
在同一层中,shuffle AUC为0.46 0.46 – 0.54 0.54:探测器读取配对,该配对会破坏,所以P3持有.

blocks.en:
Table 1 is dominated by Llama-style causal models.
We therefore re-ran the same four readouts on the same overlap-matched English bank ( n = 200 n{=}200 confirm) on other causal stacks, bidirectional encoders, and encoder–decoders.
Every loaded model satisfies P1 and P3: joint exceeds late fusion, and partner shuffle returns near chance.
Non-causal peaks sit in the main-table band—Flan-T5-base 0.953 0.953 , nli-DeBERTa 0.940 0.940 , DeBERTa-v3 0.921 0.921 —with smaller T5/BART lower but same-signed ( 0.64 0.64 – 0.66 0.66 ).
Nonce substitution of content words preserves the gap.
blocks.zh:
表1以Llama型因果模型为主.
因此,我们在同一重叠匹配的英文库(n = 200 n{=}200确认)上将相同的四个读数重新投放到其他因果堆、双向编码器和编码器上。
每一个加载的模型都满足P1和P3:关节超过晚聚变,伙伴洗牌几乎有机会返回.
非因果峰坐落于主桌乐团——. Flan-T5基座0.953 0.953,nli-DeBERTa 0.940 0.940,DeBERTa-v3 0.921 0.921 – 较小的T5/BART低但同名(0.64 0.64 – 0.66 0.66).
Nonce替换内容单词保留了空白.

blocks.en:
Four concatenation templates— A: / B: , “Sentence 1/2”, a raw separator, a blank line—yield joint confirm AUC 0.919 0.919 – 0.950 0.950 on Qwen2.5-7B (shuffle 0.47 0.47 – 0.52 0.52 ), 0.933 0.933 – 0.961 0.961 on 14B, and 0.924 0.924 – 0.967 0.967 on 32B.
Mistral 7B and Llama 3 8B at an off-peak layer on a smaller bank are more wrapper-sensitive ( 0.776 0.776 – 0.881 0.881 and 0.716 0.716 – 0.863 0.863 ), but every wrapper still beats late fusion and collapses under partner shuffle.
blocks.zh:
四个集合模板——A:/B:,"Sentence 1/2",一个原始分隔符,一个空白的线条——生成联合确认AUC 0.919 0.919 — 0.950 0.950 Quen2.5-7B(shuffle 0.47 0.47 – 0.52 0.52),0.933 0.933 – 0.961 0.961 – 14B,0.924 0.924 – 0.967 0.967 – 32B.
米斯特拉尔7B和Llama 3 8B在较小的银行的离峰层上比较有包装敏感性(0.776 0.776 – 0.881 0.881 和 0.716 0.863 ),但每件包装仍然比在伙伴洗牌下晚聚变和坍塌.

blocks.en:
On overlap-matched QQP (English confirm), joint AUC is 0.88 0.88 – 0.91 0.91 for every ≥ 3 {\geq}3 B model we ran (Qwen2.5 3B–32B, Llama, Mistral, Phi-2; Qwen7B 0.910 0.910 , 95% CI [ 0.877 , 0.943 ] [0.877,0.943] ), while late fusion rises to 0.72 0.72 – 0.77 0.77 : duplicate questions share aboutness , which PAWS’s word-scramble matching forbids and separate vectors can see.
To remove every single-sentence cue by construction we also built an anchor-balanced QQP bank: each anchor question appears exactly twice, once with a duplicate and once with an overlap-matched non-duplicate, so the first sentence carries no label information and lexical overlap alone scores 0.52 0.52 .
There, with the layer locked on development, joint AUC is 0.80 0.80 – 0.83 0.83 for all seven models (Qwen2.5 3B/7B/14B/32B, Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B, Phi-2; 95% CIs ≈ ± 0.05 \approx\pm 0.05 ), late fusion 0.55 0.55 – 0.60 0.60 , separate cosine 0.58 0.58 – 0.62 0.62 , and partner shuffle 0.42 0.42 – 0.46 0.46 ( n = 300 n{=}300 confirm).
Geometry can notice that two questions are about the same topic; certifying that they are the same question still takes the joint pass.
blocks.zh:
在重叠的QQP(英语确认)上,联合AUC为0.88 0.88 – 0.91 0.91,每 ~ 3 ~ geq}3 B型我们运行(Quen2.5 3B–32B, Llama, Mistral, Phi-2; Quen7B 0.910 0.910, 95% CI [0.877, 0.943] [0.877, 0.943])),而晚聚变则上升至0.72 0.72 — 0.77 0.77: 重复问题分享关于性的问题,PAWS的词曲匹配禁止并隔离矢量.
为了通过构建来消除每一个单一判决提示,我们还建立了一个锚平衡QQP库:每个锚问题出现两次,一次是重复的,一次是重叠的不重复的,因此第一句没有标签信息,单是词汇重叠得分0.52 0.52。
在那里,随着层层锁定在开发上,联合AUC为0.80 0.80–0.83 0.83,所有7种型号(Quen2.5 3B/7B/14B/32B,Llama 3 8B,Mistral 7B,Phi-2;95% CIS ± 0.05\pm 0.05),后聚变0.55 0.55 – 0.60 0.60, 单独 0.58 0.58 – 0.62 0.62, 合伙人洗牌0.42 0.42 0.42 – 046 0.46 (n = 300 n{=}300确认).
几何学可以注意到两个问题都是关于同一个主题的;证明这两个问题是同一个问题仍然通过联合考试.

blocks.en:
Train the linear probe on PAWS joint states, lock layer and regulariser on PAWS dev, then apply the frozen probe zero-shot: on overlap-matched QQP confirm it scores 0.72 0.72 – 0.75 0.75 (Qwen7B / Llama / Mistral / Qwen14B); on Chinese PAWS confirm—different language, different wrapper—it scores 0.745 0.745 – 0.818 0.818 , nearly the in-domain Chinese joint numbers ( 0.766 0.766 – 0.851 0.851 ); partner shuffle collapses it ( 0.48 0.48 – 0.53 0.53 ).
The reverse direction is sharper: a probe trained only on QQP reads PAWS confirm at 0.834 0.834 / 0.848 0.848 / 0.724 0.724 / 0.696 0.696 (Qwen7B / Qwen14B / Llama / Mistral) without ever seeing a PAWS pair—the Qwen directions above every independent-encoding readout we could construct on PAWS itself (best MaxSim 0.708 0.708 ), Llama and Mistral at its level.
One linear direction in mid-depth joint states carries the relation across datasets and across languages; the PAWS-tuned bi-encoder, by contrast, lost QQP accuracy relative to its own untuned checkpoint.
Transfer is partial ( 0.72 0.72 – 0.75 0.75 vs 0.88 0.88 – 0.91 0.91 in-domain): part of any probe is dataset-specific.
blocks.zh:
在PAWS联合状态上训练线性探测器,锁层和PAWSdev上的常规探测器,然后应用冷冻探测器零镜头:在重叠匹配的QQP上确认其分数为0.72 0.72 – 0.75 0.75(Quen7B / Llama / Mistral / Quen14B);在中国PAWs上确认-不同语言,不同的包装器 - 它的分数为0.745 0.745 – 0.818 ,几乎是中国域内联号(0.766 0.76 – 0.851 0.851 ); 伙伴洗牌崩溃(0.48 0.48 – 0.53 0.53 0.53).
反方向更尖锐:只接受QQP训练的探测器读作PAWS确认为0.834 0.834 / 0.848 / 0.724 0.724 / 0.696 0.696 (Quen7B / Quen14B / Llama / Mistral),从未看到过PAWS的对-每个独立编码读数上面的Wen方向,我们可以在PAWS本身(最佳MaxSim 0.708 0.708),Llama和Mistral的水平上构建.
中深联合州的一个线性方向是跨数据集和跨语言的关系;相比之下,PAWS调制的双编码器相对于自身未调制的检查点而言,QQP精度已丧失。
转让是局部的(0.72 0.72 – 0.75 0.75 – 0.88 0.88 – 0.91 0.91 内域):任何探测器的一部分都是数据集特有的.

blocks.en:
If identity is a computed relation, it should behave like an operator: teachable to a smaller joint reader, and unteachable to any function of the two independent vectors— even with the teacher’s own answers as supervision .
We treat the mid-depth joint direction of a frozen teacher (Qwen7B / Qwen14B / Mistral 7B / Llama 3 8B: PAWS confirm 0.934 0.934 / 0.945 0.945 / 0.898 0.898 / 0.895 0.895 , zero-shot QQP 0.736 0.736 / 0.710 0.710 / 0.812 0.812 / 0.737 0.737 ) as a soft labeller.
Ridge-fitting the teacher’s scores from the same model’s independently encoded last-tokens (cosine, concatenation, or product/difference features) yields confirm AUC 0.46 0.46 – 0.62 0.62 and correlation with the teacher between − 0.04 -0.04 and 0.20 0.20 : the points cannot reproduce the relation the same network computes over them.
A Qwen2.5-1.5B joint student fitted to the same soft scores—no gold labels—reaches PAWS confirm 0.85 0.85 – 0.90 0.90 under every teacher, the same band as a student trained on gold labels ( 0.86 0.86 – 0.90 0.90 ); a 3B student from the 7B teacher reaches 0.938 0.938 (teacher 0.949 0.949 )—the operator is already cheap, and teacher scores are as good as labels.
Distilling on PAWS pairs only, the student’s zero-shot QQP lags the teacher ( 0.59 0.59 – 0.71 0.71 ); adding teacher-scored unlabelled QQP pairs to the distillation set (still no gold) closes most of the gap ( 0.71 → 0.79 0.71{\to}0.79 under Mistral, teacher 0.81 0.81 ; 0.69 → 0.73 0.69{\to}0.73 under Llama; 0.63 → 0.67 0.63{\to}0.67 under 7B).
The operator distils from unlabelled pairs while the aboutness encoder stays frozen; installing it in the vectors is the STS-taxed fit above.
blocks.zh:
如果身份是一种计算的关系,那么它就应该表现得像一个操作员:可以教给一个较小的联读器,不能教给两个独立载体的任何功能——即使教师自己的回答是监督。
我们把冷冻教师的中深联合方向(Quen7B / Quen14B / Mistral 7B / Llama 3 8B:PAWS确认0.934 0.934 / 0.945 0.998 0.898 / 0.895 0.895 零发QQP 0.736 0.736 / 0.710 0.710 / 0.812 0.812 / 0.737 0.737)当作软标签.

一张文2.5-1.5 配上同样软分的B联合学生——没有金牌——到达PAWS确认每名教师下为0.85 0.85 – 0.90 0.90,与接受过金牌训练的学生下为同一带(0.86 0.86 – 0.90 0.90);7B教师3B学生达到0.938 0.938(教师0.949 0.949)——操作员已经很便宜,教师的分数也和标签一样好.

blocks.en:
Peak joint is not the final residual (Figure 2 ).
Llama and Mistral peak at layer 16 of 32; Qwen7B at layer 21 of 28; Qwen14B at layer 36 of 48; GPT-2 XL at layer 24 of 48.
Postnorm joint is systematically lower than the mid-depth peak, but families differ in how much they overwrite: Llama 0.73 0.73 vs 0.90 0.90 (Qwen14B only 0.940 0.940 vs 0.950 0.950 )—Qwen keeps what it computed, Llama spends it on next-token prediction.
Either way, the object used as a sentence embedding—the final residual of a separately encoded string—never held the relation, and a final-norm edit that wrecks next-token prediction does not create it: permuting the RMSNorm gain on Qwen2.5-7B yields KL 36 36 against the untouched head (top-1 agreement 0.4 % 0.4\% ) while separate cosine stays 0.558 0.558 versus 0.561 0.561 ; Llama, Mistral, 14B, and the mute small models all stay in 0.55 0.55 – 0.62 0.62 under the same edits.
blocks.zh:
峰关节不是最终残留(图2).
Llama和Mistral峰为32层第16层;Quen7B为28层第21层;Quen14B为48层第36层;GPT-2 XL为48层第24层.

无论如何,用作嵌入句子的物体——一个单独编码的字符串的最后剩余部分——从未持有过关系,而破坏下个触控预测的最后规范编辑不会产生这种关系:在Quen2.5-7B上使 RMSNorm 增益在未切除头部(最高-1协议0.4% 0.4========================================================================================================================================================================================= 0.561; Llama, Mistral, 14B, 哑小型号都停留在0.55 0.55 – 0.62 0.62 在同一编辑下.

blocks.en: Chinese confirm repeats the pattern at lower amplitude for multilingual models (joint 0.77 0.77 – 0.85 0.85 vs late fusion 0.54 0.54 – 0.60 0.60 ) and vanishes for GPT-2, which was not trained on Chinese.

blocks.en: One operator across independently trained models
blocks.zh: 1名操作员跨越独立培训的模型

blocks.en:
If identity is a computed relation rather than a criterion fitted to a dataset, then models trained by different organisations on different corpora should compute the same relation.
Each of six models (Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B/7B/14B, Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B) gets its joint direction located once , on PAWS English discovery, then frozen; all six score the same held-out items.
blocks.zh:
如果身份是计算的关系而不是数据集的标准,那么不同组织对不同公司进行训练的模型就应计算同一关系。
6个型号(Quen2.5 1.5B/3B/7B/14B,Llama 3 8B,Mistral 7B)的每个型号,一旦在PAWS英语发现上找到其联合方向,然后被冻结;所有6个型号都得到相同的被搁置项目.

blocks.en:
On PAWS confirm, pairwise Spearman between models’ item scores averages 0.855 0.855 ; restricted to cross-family pairs (Qwen vs Llama vs Mistral) it is 0.834 0.834 .
Agreement is not explained by the binary label: ranking within the paraphrases alone, or within the non-paraphrases alone, cross-family agreement is still 0.61 0.61 – 0.62 0.62 —six models agree on how much the same each pair is.
blocks.zh:
在PAWS确认时,模型项目之间对偶的Spearman平均得分为0.855 0.855;仅限于跨家族对对(Quen vs Llama vs Mistral)是0.834 0.834。
二进制标签不解释协议:单在准句内或单在非准句内排名,跨家庭协议仍为0.61 0.61 – 0.62 0.62 – 六种模式商定每对的相同程度.

blocks.en:
Where one model errs, the others err: P ⁡ ( B wrong ∣ A wrong ) P(\text{B wrong}\mid\text{A wrong}) exceeds the base rate by 2.9 2.9 – 5.7 × 5.7\times on PAWS, and the seven items that all six models get wrong are three orders of magnitude more frequent than independent errors would allow.
Averaging the six z-scored outputs does not beat the best single model ( 0.963 0.963 vs 0.970 0.970 on PAWS; 0.773 0.773 vs 0.778 0.778 on QQP): the models share the residual as well as the signal.
blocks.zh:
当一个模型出错时,另一个模型出错: P QQ (B wrong QQ A wrong) P(\text{B wrong {mid\text{A wrong}) 在PAWS上超过基准率2.9 2.9 — 5.7×5.7\时,所有六个模型出错的七个项目都是三个数量级,比独立错误允许的更频繁.
显示6个z分数的输出不能击败最佳单机型(PAWS上的0.963 0.963对0.970 0.970;QQP上的0.773 0.773对0.778 0.778):该型号既共享剩余,也共享信号.

blocks.en:
Swapping the sentences barely moves the score ( score ⁡ ( A , B ) \mathrm{score}(A,B) vs score ⁡ ( B , A ) \mathrm{score}(B,A) Spearman 0.89 0.89 – 0.93 0.93 on PAWS), and the forward–swap discrepancy carries no label information (AUC 0.50 0.50 – 0.61 0.61 ).
Applied zero-shot to SNLI, every one of the six directions orders PAWS paraphrase > > entailment > > neutral > > contradiction > > PAWS non-paraphrase, monotonically in the mean, with entailment-vs-contradiction AUC 0.79 0.79 – 0.98 0.98 : a direction located with binary labels measures degree .
blocks.zh:
翻转句子几乎不会移动分数(分数QQ(A,B)\mathrm{score}(A,B)对分QQ(B,A)\mathrm{score}(B,A)Spearman 0.89 0.89 0.89 – 0.93 0.93 在PAWS上),前面的-swap差异没有标注信息(AUC 0.50 0.50 – 0.61 0.61).
对 SNLI 应用零射线,六个方向中每一个方向都命令 PAWS 参数 > > completement > > 中性 > > 矛盾 > PAWS 非参数,在平均值中为单调,带有内含-vs-contraction ACUC 0.79 0.79 – 0.98 0.98:一个方向,带有二进制标签的度量衡度.

blocks.en:
On overlap-matched QQP confirm, all six models contradict the published label on 18 18 items ( 57 × 57\times the independence rate).
Six of them ( 2.4 % 2.4\% of the bank) are confident ( | z | > 1 |z|>1 ).
Consensus AUC against those published labels is 0.773 0.773 .
Transfer of the frozen PAWS coordinate is partial on overlap-matched MRPC ( 0.48 0.48 – 0.61 0.61 ), and where it transfers less the six models also agree less (frozen-coordinate QQP: pairwise Spearman 0.34 0.34 – 0.84 0.84 , error lift 1.3 1.3 – 2.3 × 2.3\times ): the invariant is the relation, and each dataset’s coordinate onto it is only partly shared.
blocks.zh:
在重叠匹配的QQP确认上,所有6个型号都与18个项目上公布的标签相矛盾(57×57\时独立率).
其中6个(银行的2.4% 2.4%)是自信的(  z  > 1 z|>1).
AUC对公布的标签的共识为0.773 0.773。
冷冻PAWS坐标的转移部分针对重叠匹配的MRPC(0.48 0.38 – 0.61 0.61),如果转移较少的6种型号,也同意较少(冷冻坐标QQP:双向Spearman 0.34 – 0.84 – 0.84 ,错误升降1.3 – 2.3 × 2.3\时): 每个数据集的坐标只是部分共享。

blocks.en:
Finally we train a model on the invariant itself: a Qwen2.5-1.5B reader (four mid-depth blocks unfrozen, linear head on the mid layer) regresses the consensus of three cross-family teachers (Qwen7B, Llama 3 8B, Mistral 7B; pairwise pool correlation 0.73 0.73 – 0.82 0.82 ) on ∼ 10 {\sim}10 k unlabelled English pairs.
No gold pair label enters anywhere past locating each teacher’s coordinate.
The student reaches PAWS confirm 0.959 0.959 —matching the 7B teacher’s own probe ( 0.956 0.956 ) and above every single-teacher distillation of § 5 —QQP 0.774 0.774 , and Chinese PAWS 0.758 0.758 zero-shot from English-only training text: what survives distillation across families and languages is the computed quantity.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们训练一个模型 在变化无常本身: a Quen2.5-1.5B阅读器(四个中深层块解冻,中间层为线性头部)使三位跨家庭教师(Quen7B,Llama 3 8B,Mistral 7B;对偶池关联0.73 0.73 – 0.82 0.82)在 10 {\sim}10 k 个无标签的英语对子上的共识倒退.
校对:Soup
学生到达PAWS确认0.959 0.959 — 匹配7B教师自己的探测器(0.956 0.956)以及每一次单师蒸馏§5 → P 0.774 0.774,中国PAWS 0.758 0.758 零射出只使用英语的训练文本:在家庭和语言蒸馏中存活下来的是计算数量.

blocks.en: Scale, family, and a fossil that grows
blocks.zh: 规模,家族, 和一种生长的化石

blocks.en:
Two scale stories are easy to confuse: computation as a Qwen idiosyncrasy, versus computation as the default organisation of modern LMs, which older English LMs grow more slowly; Llama 3 and Mistral—not Qwen, not instruction-tuned—close the first.
Instruction tuning is not the cause either: Qwen2.5-1.5B base already reaches 0.916 0.916 (instruct 0.947 0.947 ; 7B-Instruct 0.961 0.961 with late fusion still 0.529 0.529 ).
blocks.zh:
两个尺度故事容易混淆:计算为Quen idiosyncrasy,与计算为现代LMs的默认组织,较老的英语LMs增长较慢;Llama 3和Mistral——不是Quen,不是指令调制——关闭第一个.
指令调音也不是原因: Quen2.5-1.5B 基地已经达到0.916 0.916(指示0.947 0.947;7B-指示0.961 0.961,后聚变仍为0.529 0.529)。

blocks.en:
Inside Qwen2.5 the joint circuit is a scale law with an early ceiling, not a 7B accident: 0.789 0.789 (0.5B) → \to 0.916 0.916 (1.5B) → \to 0.937 0.937 (3B) → \to 0.941 0.941 (7B) → \to 0.950 0.950 (14B) → \to 0.938 0.938 (32B, 95% CI [ 0.897 , 0.969 ] [0.897,0.969] ), with late fusion at 32B still chance ( 0.493 0.493 ).
Once the model is large enough to compute the pair, more parameters compute it more cleanly, then stop gaining, and never move the relation into the vectors.

The older families run the same curve more slowly (Table 1 , lower block): GPT-2 climbs 0.665 / 0.688 / 0.652 / 0.756 0.665/0.688/0.652/0.756 (small/medium/large/XL) with late fusion pinned near chance—a long plateau, then a jump at XL.
The plateau-and-jump repeats in every lineage we ran: TinyLlama-1.1B and Phi-1.5 already split joint 0.778 0.778 vs late ≈ 0.54 {\approx}0.54 and Phi-2 is that family’s jump ( 0.893 0.893 ); SmolLM2 goes 0.753 → 0.843 0.753\to 0.843 ; GPT-Neo 0.680 → 0.815 0.680\to 0.815 and GPT-J-6B 0.868 0.868 ; OPT sits flat at 0.658 0.658 – 0.674 0.674 through 1.3B and jumps to 0.829 0.829 at 6.7B; Pythia stalls at 0.611 0.611 – 0.727 0.727 ; none puts the relation in the vectors.
The mouth is optional
blocks.zh: 嘴是可选的

A joint probe reads a state.
A user of a chatbot reads tokens.
On a smaller overlap-matched draw ( n = 150 n{=}150 – 300 300 confirm), the two channels come apart by family.

blocks.en: Qwen base models can say the answer: zero-shot verdict AUC 0.915 0.915 at 3B, 0.938 0.938 at 7B (matching its joint probe 0.941 0.941 ), 0.960 0.960 at 14B, 0.987 0.987 at 32B—while length-normalised PMI stays 0.47 0.47 – 0.61 0.61 throughout (7B-Instruct verdict 0.915 0.915 : instruction tuning is not what opens the mouth).

Llama 3 8B and Mistral 7B are the other half of the split: joint probes 0.897 0.897 and 0.915 0.915 , verdicts 0.614 0.614 and 0.606 0.606 —they compute identity and then refuse to utter it.
Every older or smaller family we ran does the same (GPT-2 verdicts 0.47 0.47 – 0.51 0.51 against joint up to 0.756 0.756 ; Phi 0.56 0.56 – 0.61 0.61 against 0.778 0.778 – 0.893 0.893 ).
Prompting is not a substitute for the joint state: PMI does not recover it, and conditional surprisal sits at 0.55 0.55 – 0.76 0.76 for every model, unrelated to the joint probe (OPT-350M 0.76 0.76 against joint 0.66 0.66 ).

Llama 3 8B和Mistral 7B是分裂的另一半:联合探测器0.897 0.897和0.915 0.915,判决0.614 0.614和0.606 0.606——他们计算身份,然后拒绝说.
我们所竞选的每个年长或较小的家庭都这样做(GPT-2判决为0.47 0.47 – 0.51 0.51 – 0.756 – 0.56 – Phi 0.56 – 0.61 – 0.61 – 0.778 – 0.893 – 0.893 ).
催化不是联合状态的替代品:PMI不恢复,有条件的悬浮座坐落于0.55 0.55 – 0.76 0.76,每种型号,与联合探测无关(OPT-350M 0.76 0.76对联合0.66 0.66).

blocks.en: What this is worth in the world
blocks.zh: 这在世界上的价值

blocks.en:
Dense retrieval compares sentence vectors because it is cheap; on wording twins that comparison is the wrong object.
We built two fully automatic FAQ stacks (frozen BGE index, top-10 recall, then a certification step; abstention thresholds set on a disjoint dev split; no human scoring anywhere).
The Quora bank (800 canonical QQP questions, 425 same-topic hard negatives, 1,500 distractors; queries are held-out duplicate partners) is the world where restated questions still share words, so surface overlap is legitimate evidence: recall@10 0.994 0.994 , cosine top-1 0.862 0.862 , in/out abstention AUC 0.985 0.985 .
There the PAWS-located direction used alone is worse than cosine (top-1 0.427 0.427 ): a coordinate located on word-scramble pairs does not rank restated questions, whose twins differ in topic granularity rather than word order; located on 500 in-domain pairs it certifies at 0.800 0.800 , and fused with cosine every operator matches cosine’s top-1 while lowering false answers on out-of-KB queries ( 0.125 → 0.094 0.125\to 0.094 ): the operator certifies a candidate list, it does not replace recall.
The trap bank is the same stack over PAWS sentences (KB of 2,222 entries): 375 of 1,289 canonical entries have a word-swap twin inside the KB, and each of 300 out-of-KB queries has its meaning-changed twin in the KB.
Cosine collapses exactly there: top-1 0.468 0.468 on trapped queries, and it confidently answers 99 % 99\% of out-of-KB queries—always with the wrong twin.
The frozen PAWS direction of § 5 , with zero in-domain labels, certifies the same top-10 at 0.83 0.83 on trapped queries; fused with cosine it reaches 0.90 0.90 overall, matching a prompted 7B verdict ( 0.903 0.903 )—a channel only the Qwen family can speak (§ 8 )—while confident wrong answers fall from 0.284 0.284 to 0.096 0.096 .
The consensus-trained 1.5B reader of § 6 reproduces this end to end ( 0.844 0.844 alone, 0.900 0.900 fused) with no gold labels and no 7B at inference.
blocks.zh:
Dense reference比较句式矢量,因为它很便宜;在措辞上双胞胎认为比较是错误的对象.
我们建造了两个完全自动的 FAQ 堆栈(冻结的 BGE 指数,前十名召回,然后是认证步骤;在脱节的dev 拆分上设定的弃权阈值;任何地方都没有人类得分).
Quora银行(800 canonical QQP问题,425个同题硬底片,1500个分心器;询问被搁置的重复合作伙伴)是重覆的问题仍然有相同词句的世界,所以表面重叠是合法的证据: record@10 0.994 0.994,cosine top-1 0.862 0.862, in/out aUC 0.985 0.985.
在那里,单使用的PAWS定位方向比余弦更差(顶-1 0.427 0.427):位于单词组合的坐标不排列重复的问题,其双胞胎在专题颗粒度上不同,而不是单词顺序不同;位于单词组合的500对域中,它于0.800 0.800 被证明,并且与每名操作员的余弦相匹配,同时降低在KB以外的查询中的错误答案(0.125 ~ 0.094 0.125\\\= 0.094):操作员认证候选人名单,它不会取代召回。
陷阱库在PAWS句子上是同一个堆栈(2,222个条目的KB):在1,289个犬类条目中,375个在KB内部有一个单词擦拭双胞胎,每个300个出KB查询在KB中都有其意义变化的双胞胎.
余弦的崩溃正好就在那里:在被困的询问上排在前-1 0.468 0 468,它自信地回答了99%的KB以外的询问——总是错误的双胞胎.
冻结的PAWS方向为§5,内置标签为零,在被困查询上以0.83 0.83验证相同的上-10;与余弦结合,整体达到0.90 0.90,符合一个引发的7B判决(0.903 0.903)——一个只有Quen家族能说话的频道(§8)——同时自信的错误答案从0.284 0.284 0.284降至0.096 0.096.
第6节经协商一致培训的1.5B阅读器复制到这一端(仅0.844 0.844,0.900 0.900 引信),没有金色标签,也没有7B推论。

blocks.en:
The practical reading: retrieve with embeddings; certify identity with a joint pass.
The operator is cheap to own, and the aboutness index stays frozen (BGE-base STS-B Spearman stays 0.895 0.895 ).
blocks.zh:
实用读法:用嵌入式检索;用联合通行证验证身份.
运营商廉价拥有,相关指数仍然冻结(BGE-base STS-B Spearman stay 0.895 0.895 ).

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Scope is PAWS-style paraphrase under overlap matching.
Independent-encoding readers trail the joint probe even at 49 49 k training pairs; cross-architecture amplitude varies while the joint-versus-late sign does not; Llama 3 / Mistral compute the relation ( 0.90 0.90 ) without verbalising it ( 0.61 0.61 ).
blocks.zh:
范围是重叠匹配下的PAWS风格的参数。
独立编码读取器跟踪联合探测器,甚至以49对49千米的训练对;跨结构振幅不同,而联合对晚号则不同; Llama 3 / Mistral 计算关系(0.90 0.90 )而不用口头(0.61 0.61 ).

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: Meaning identity on overlap-matched PAWS-X is a joint-pass computation, not a property of frozen independent embeddings: the gap holds across causal, encoder, and encoder–decoder families, survives nonce substitution, is shared across training houses, and distils into a cheap reader that repairs a cosine FAQ stack.
blocks.zh: 在重叠匹配的 PAWS- X 上表示身份是一种联合-通过计算,而不是冷冻的独立嵌入物的属性: 空隙存在于因果、编码器和编码器-解码器家族之间,在非ce替换后存活下来,在训练所之间共享,并分解成一个廉价的阅读器,用于修复一个cosine FAQ堆.

blocks.en: Code, scripts, and result dumps will be released in a public repository in a subsequent update of this preprint.
blocks.zh: 代码,脚本,以及结果堆将在此预印的随后更新中发布在公共寄存器中.
